NASA Earth 3D Model
Credit: NASA Visualization Technology Applications and Development (VTAD)
Source: https://science.nasa.gov/resource/earth-3d-model/
Requested embed: https://solarsystem.nasa.gov/gltf_embed/2393/
Asset: Earth_1_12756.glb, bundled unchanged as earth-nasa.glb.
Model orientation and scale are applied at runtime.
This model is a historical visualization, not live imagery.

Fallback asset:
NASA Blue Marble (2002), land surface, ocean color and sea ice.
Source image:
https://eoimages.gsfc.nasa.gov/images/imagerecords/57000/57730/land_ocean_ice_2048.jpg
Source page:
https://science.nasa.gov/earth/earth-observatory/the-blue-marble-true-color-global-imagery-at-1km-resolution/
Credit: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Reto Stockli / Robert Simmon and the
MODIS teams, with additional data from USGS and partner data contributors.
This is a historical satellite mosaic, not a current or live Earth observation.
